honesty: Underwater depths, substrates and habitats are AUTHORED: no real bathymetry is held, so this is not a chart and not for navigation. Shorelines are RECORDED only where the Natural Earth 10m vendor clip covers them (1:10,000,000, coarse). Eelgrass, oyster reef, mudflat and riprap are generic set dressing at AUTHORED places, not surveyed beds. Dive and ROV here are a game camera for monitoring practice - not dive training and not dive-safety instruction. Animals are never harmed.
